denied_syscalls.name: acct
denied_syscalls.reason: Requires CAP_SYS_PACCT.

denied_syscalls.name: add_key
denied_syscalls.reason: Accepts attacker-controlled variable-size payloads.

denied_syscalls.name: bpf
denied_syscalls.reason: Loads eBPF programs and maps, exposing a historically CVE-rich privilege-escalation and information-leak surface.

denied_syscalls.name: chroot
denied_syscalls.reason: Facilitates sandbox escape.

denied_syscalls.name: clone3
denied_syscalls.reason: Can hide CLONE_NEW namespace flags behind a pointer that seccomp cannot inspect.

denied_syscalls.name: create_module
denied_syscalls.reason: Creates kernel module memory, enabling arbitrary kernel-code execution.

denied_syscalls.name: delete_module
denied_syscalls.reason: Can remove security modules or trigger module-unload races.

denied_syscalls.name: finit_module
denied_syscalls.reason: Loads a kernel module, enabling arbitrary kernel-code execution.

denied_syscalls.name: fsconfig
denied_syscalls.reason: Configures new mount API filesystem contexts with power equivalent to mount.

denied_syscalls.name: fsmount
denied_syscalls.reason: Creates mounts through the new mount API, bypassing a mount-only denial.

denied_syscalls.name: fsopen
denied_syscalls.reason: Creates filesystem contexts for the new mount API, bypassing a mount-only denial.

denied_syscalls.name: fspick
denied_syscalls.reason: Selects existing mounts for reconfiguration through the new mount API.

denied_syscalls.name: init_module
denied_syscalls.reason: Loads a kernel module, enabling arbitrary kernel-code execution.

denied_syscalls.name: io_uring_enter
denied_syscalls.reason: Executes io_uring operations that can bypass syscall-level file and network filtering.

denied_syscalls.name: io_uring_register
denied_syscalls.reason: Registers io_uring resources through a young, historically CVE-rich kernel subsystem.

denied_syscalls.name: io_uring_setup
denied_syscalls.reason: Creates io_uring instances that expose a young, historically CVE-rich kernel subsystem.

denied_syscalls.name: ioperm
denied_syscalls.reason: Grants direct x86 I/O-port access that bypasses normal kernel device mediation.

denied_syscalls.name: iopl
denied_syscalls.reason: Raises x86 I/O privilege, allowing direct hardware access outside normal kernel mediation.

denied_syscalls.name: kcmp
denied_syscalls.reason: Compares kernel resources across processes and can leak information about shared resources.

denied_syscalls.name: kexec_file_load
denied_syscalls.reason: Loads a replacement kernel image, enabling complete host takeover.

denied_syscalls.name: kexec_load
denied_syscalls.reason: Loads a replacement kernel image, enabling complete host takeover.

denied_syscalls.name: keyctl
denied_syscalls.reason: Accepts attacker-controlled variable-size payloads.

denied_syscalls.name: madvise
denied_syscalls.reason: Can help trigger race conditions.

denied_syscalls.name: mount
denied_syscalls.reason: Can remount host filesystems or strip protection flags, defeating filesystem confinement.

denied_syscalls.name: mount_setattr
denied_syscalls.reason: Can clear read-only, nosuid, or nodev attributes from sandbox mounts.

denied_syscalls.name: move_mount
denied_syscalls.reason: Relocates mounts through the new mount API and exposes the same escape surface as mount.

denied_syscalls.name: open_tree
denied_syscalls.reason: Clones mount trees into file descriptors that can be detached and reattached.

denied_syscalls.name: pivot_root
denied_syscalls.reason: Repoints the process root filesystem and can undo the sandbox root boundary.

denied_syscalls.name: process_vm_readv
denied_syscalls.reason: Reads another process's address space directly, enabling secret theft.

denied_syscalls.name: process_vm_writev
denied_syscalls.reason: Writes another process's address space directly, enabling code injection.

denied_syscalls.name: ptrace
denied_syscalls.reason: Controls other processes and can read or modify their memory and registers.

denied_syscalls.name: reboot
denied_syscalls.reason: Can reboot or halt the host, causing whole-machine denial of service.

denied_syscalls.name: request_key
denied_syscalls.reason: Accesses kernel keyring management, a historically UAF- and refcount-bug-prone surface.

denied_syscalls.name: setns
denied_syscalls.reason: Joins an existing namespace and could re-enter host mount, network, or PID namespaces.

denied_syscalls.name: umount
denied_syscalls.reason: Can detach protective mounts and expose underlying host filesystem content.

denied_syscalls.name: umount2
denied_syscalls.reason: Can detach protective mounts and expose underlying host filesystem content.

denied_syscalls.name: unshare
denied_syscalls.reason: Creates new namespaces, including user namespaces that grant capabilities within the new namespace.

denied_syscalls.name: userfaultfd
denied_syscalls.reason: Provides userspace page-fault handling used to widen race windows and groom kernel memory.
